snippet.title: Mighty Aphid - 1.1 Update Teaser
snippet.description:
Grab it here! https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mighty-aphid/id1493364612

Mighty Aphid has been updated to version 1.1!

- ✌️ two new levels
- 💭 the chat box slides in from the top instead of the bottom
- 😎 new HUD
- 💎 multi-colored gems 
- 💀 fancier death animation
- ✅ Many bug fixes and improvements
